title: Ribbed shell roof with diagonal bracing
summary: Turns any freeform surface into a roof structure: a two-way grid of deep ribs follows the surface's U and V directions, and every bay between ribs gets a pair of crossing diagonal braces at the top of the ribs.
how_to_use: Right-click 'Base Srf' and choose Set one Surface to pick your own roof surface (a sample surface is already stored in the file).
Change 'Ribs U' and 'Ribs V' to set how many bays the roof is divided into in each direction.
'Rib depth' sets how tall the ribs are, in model units; the braces sit on top of the ribs.
'Brace radius' sets the thickness of the diagonal rods.
Right-click the Pipe and the two Custom Preview components, then Bake, to get the geometry into Rhino.
concepts: UV parameter space: Range + Construct Point make points in the surface's 0..1 domain, not in XYZ
Iso Curve: a curve that follows the surface at a constant U or V
Divide Domain2 + Isotrim: cutting a surface into a grid of sub-surfaces (bays)
List Item with several outputs: picking the corners 0,1,2,3 of each bay to draw diagonals
One vector (Unit Z x depth) reused for extrusion and for moving the braces up

steps.title: 1  INPUTS - change these
steps.explain: The roof surface and four numbers. Everything to the right is rebuilt live from these.

steps.title: 2  Rib grid from isocurves
steps.explain: Two Range components split the surface domain 0..1 into equal steps. Construct Point combines them into UV points, and Iso Curve draws the U and V curves through each point. Each curve is extruded straight up by Unit Z x Rib depth, giving vertical rib plates that follow the roof.

steps.title: 3  Diagonal bracing in every bay
steps.explain: Divide Domain2 cuts the same domain into U x V cells and Isotrim turns each cell into a small sub-surface (a bay). Deconstruct Brep gives each bay's four corner points; List Item picks corners 0-2 and 1-3 so two Lines cross the bay. The lines are moved up by the rib depth and piped into round braces.

steps.title: 4  RESULT - preview and bake
steps.explain: Custom Preview shows the base surface and the ribs in the colours of the swatches. Bake these (and the Pipe in step 3) to keep the geometry.

harness.audit_note: Harnessed at XML level on 2026-10-25 from the teaching file; not yet solved live. To audit: open capsules/structure-shell-roof-ribs.harnessed.ghx in Grasshopper (Rhino 8), confirm it solves with the sample and that every ALMOND_OUT_* param carries data, reference your own surface into ALMOND_IN_BASE_SRF and change the numbers, then set harness.audited to true in this lesson and rebuild.
harness.description_for_llm: Generates a ribbed shell roof: a two-way grid of vertical rib plates following a surface's U and V isocurves, with a pair of crossing diagonal braces on top of every bay. Inputs are all in the Rhino document's units (the upstream file was authored in metres: 16 x 10 bays, rib depth 1.8, brace radius 0.08, a 54 x 30 sample surface about 10 high). Give ALMOND_IN_BASE_SRF one single-face brep (a surface); polysurfaces fail because Iso Curve and Isotrim need one face. Omit it to build the stored sample roof. The axis outputs (rib isocurves, moved brace lines) are what validate_structure needs as members once sections are assigned with almond:section user text; the solid outputs are the drawn ribs (extrusions) and braces (pipes). Every geometry output is baked into the active document. The 2026-10-20 stress test took this roof (34 ribs, 320 braces, 764 exported members) through validate_structure in about a minute.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_BASE_SRF
inputs.description: Roof surface as one single-face brep, in document units. Omit to use the sample surface stored in the file (54 x 30, about 10 high, authored in metres).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_RIBS_U
inputs.description: Number of rib bays along the surface's U direction (whole number; also the U isocurve count minus one).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_RIBS_V
inputs.description: Number of rib bays along the surface's V direction (whole number).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_RIB_DEPTH
inputs.description: Rib height: each isocurve is extruded straight up by this distance, and the braces sit at the top of the ribs.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_BRACE_RADIUS
inputs.description: Radius of the round diagonal braces (Pipe).

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_RIB_AXES
outputs.description: Rib centrelines: the U and V isocurves on the base surface, before extrusion. Members for validate_structure.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_BRACE_AXES
outputs.description: Brace centrelines: the two bay diagonals per bay, already moved up by the rib depth. Members for validate_structure.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_RIBS
outputs.description: The rib plates as extruded surfaces (U ribs, then V ribs).
